name: Patient-Aligned MPR Plane Construction
definition: A method to construct an MPR (Multi-Planar Reformation) plane aligned with patient anatomy (LPS coordinate system) given a plane type (axial, coronal, sagittal), center point, dimensions, and pixel spacing.
summary: Patient-Aligned MPR Plane Construction generates anatomical planes aligned with standard LPS axes for multi-planar reformation, differing from other methods by enforcing strict anatomical alignment rather than arbitrary perpendicularity.
